scope.method: Source-owned reusable CSS primitives supplement the React renderer denominator. These are extra owners, not new React catalog witness IDs. Source inspection establishes ownership; rendered captures must independently establish values.
scope.boundary: Reusable intrinsic grid/flow/list relationships are in scope. Column counts, spans and application shell allocation are external layout boundaries. Story chrome and orphan CSS do not enter the live-owner denominator.

extras.fixtureRequirement: A real .grid with at least two occupied rows and columns; default gaps plus separately documented per-axis overrides. Do not infer vertical used separation from a single-row grid.
extras.reason: The CSS primitive owns sibling gaps independently of a React renderer. Cards and ContentLayout consume related grid mechanisms; their presence does not account for this owner.

extras.fixtureRequirement: At least two baseline-governed direct children retaining their own metric compensation.
extras.reason: The reusable stack owns semantic separation. Its children's typography compensation is a distinct relationship and must not be removed by the specimen.

extras.fixtureRequirement: At least two direct text/component children, without story-level margin normalization.
extras.reason: Editorial is a live reusable flow primitive, not merely documentation chrome. It reads the shared field gap independently of component insets.

extras.fixtureRequirement: Real unordered and ordered lists outside .ds component-owned list resets. Both must remain visible; do not restyle their inset in the fixture.
extras.reason: Bare lists visibly exercise the shared canvas-plus-gap composition. Existing Category and Breadcrumb witnesses reset their native lists and therefore do not measure this rule.
